measurement_contract.required: unique pixel/sample ID, geometry, epi/contact/package revision, I-V and P-I with uncertainty, J and junction/ambient temperature, repeatability
complex S11 or impedance vs bias/frequency/T at a calibrated device plane; OPEN/SHORT/LOAD/deembedding or equivalent calibration; RF voltage and current; small-signal amplitude
complex S21 (magnitude+phase) and noise floor/dark/background; absolute gain if optical energy is needed; calibrated PD/TIA and fiber response; confirm linearity at 25uA
fit electrical and optical response together; hold out bias/T points; preserve passivity/causality and confidence/correlation; choose either full measured chain or separately deembedded blocks
large-signal P-I/dynamics and pattern-dependent response; optical loss, RX noise/bandwidth, jitter and temperature; fixed payload/frame overhead; BER qualification separately

candidate_implementation: Bias-indexed Z_LED(s,I,T) fitted to complex electrical data plus residual H_EO(s,I,T) fitted after removing calibrated electrical/receiver blocks; static nonlinear I-V/P-I and charge/lifetime state must be mutually consistent. Validate small-signal first, then 25–100uA transitions. No coefficients assigned until evidence exists.
non_identifiability_counterexample: H(s) and H(s)*exp(-s*100ps) have identical magnitude but different sampling delay; code verifies this algebraically.
boundary: temperature and physical-sample covariance remain unknown; not silicon/optical validation of this project
